Name: Auto Catch Fish Mod
Author: WillTheMage
Description:
[b]Auto Catch Fish Mod
[/b]
This mod makes fishing easier

He skips the fishing minigame, and when the fish catches him, he will automatically pull

You just need to cast the bait and relax

Each fishing level improves the chance of catching higher quality fish, at level 10 fishing increases the chances by 30%

I wanted to fish while watching some videos and I was getting stuck, so I made this mod

I'm playing the game right now, I'll soon play and create mods for other games, so I can't keep updating this mod.

I only tested it on version 1.6 which I'm currently playing.
